subject: Contradictory feedback for RD candidate — need quick reconciliation
message_1_subject: Contradictory feedback for RD candidate — need quick reconciliation
message_1_body:
Team,

Quick one: attached are the resume and the raw scorecards from today’s loop for Elena Park (SWE, routing/embeddings experience). We have a pretty split panel — Marissa gave a low technical score but very high product/culture notes; Karthik gave strong technical but flagged role fit concerns. Monica (hiring mgr) and I need a short reconciliation before we either move to a take-home or close.

Please: 1) add a 1–2 sentence rationale for any score that differs by more than 2 points from the median, 2) fill the single-row consolidated scorecard in the Drive link below (named "Elena_Park_consolidated.xlsx"), and 3) reply with final +/- hire recommendation (hire / hold / no hire) by EOD Pacific.

Why: recruiting wants a clear next step for the candidate and we should avoid score drift in the packet we send to interviewers reviewing the take-home.

Attachments: Elena_Park_Resume.pdf, raw_scorecards_park.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1G-Interview-Packets/Elena_Park
Greenhouse: https://greenhouse.example.com/candidates/29384

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisitions
Redwood Inference

On a related note: if anyone thinks we should skip the take-home and go straight to an on-site, flag it in your reply with a short reason.
message_2_subject: Re: Contradictory feedback for RD candidate — need quick reconciliation
message_2_body:
Thanks Rachel — quick context from my side.

Short version: my low technical score reflects depth on distributed KV cache design and long-context performance; Elena correctly described high-level approaches but could not sketch a concrete cache-eviction/consistency plan under multi-tenant constraints. For a senior SWE on our infra team that gap matters.

I added a 3-line note in marissa_technical_notes.txt (attached) and populated the consolidated row with a 4/10 technical, 8/10 product/culture. Recommendation: hold for now — consider take-home only if role shifts to more product-adjacent infra.

--
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Staff SWE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
message_3_subject: Re: Contradictory feedback for RD candidate — need quick reconciliation
message_3_body:
Appreciate the notes — quick pushback from my side: my strong technical score (8/10) is based on Elena's systems trade-off thinking in the second exercise and the latency-cost reasoning she demonstrated. She was specific about KV cache sharding and quantization trade-offs.

Proposal to reconcile quickly: use a weighted average for the packet we send — 60% technical, 30% product/pm fit, 10% culture. That produces a technical-leaning view but still captures product match. If we still disagree >1.5 points after weighting, let's do a 20–30 min calibration call (I can be free 11:30–12:00 or 15:00–15:30 PT).

I populated the consolidated sheet with my weights and left a short comment in the Drive file. If we agree on weights now, Rachel, please summarize for recruiting.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
message_4_subject: Re: Contradictory feedback for RD candidate — need quick reconciliation
message_4_body:
Thanks all — good thread and helpful detail. Final decision from my side: use Karthik’s weighted approach (60/30/10) for the packet we send to recruiting. After applying the weights and reviewing the consolidated row, the overall score lands in the "proceed" band but with caveats on deep infra ownership.

Decision path:
- Proceed to a focused take-home that targets cache consistency + scaling under multi-tenant traffic (45–60 minutes).
- Karthik, can you draft two take-home tasks (one primary, one optional stretch) by EOD tomorrow?
- Marissa: you'll own review of the take-home output (please flag any fundamental gaps) — thanks for the detailed notes.
- Rachel: update Greenhouse and schedule the take-home with Elena; copy Asha so she can pass timelines to the candidate. Please include the consolidated scorecard and a short note on the calibration outcome.

Attachments: Elena_Park_Resume.pdf (for recruiting); raw_scorecards_park.xlsx (archival)

If we hit another big split after take-home, we'll do a 20-minute calibration with panelists.

Monica
